fusionfix.notes: Install first; the DLAA installer expects a clean FusionFix baseline.

dlss-full.product_name: DLSS 4.5 Super Resolution + DLSS 5 Neural Rendering
dlss-full.settings_surface: Home -> Add-ons -> DLSS 5 Feed -> GTA IV DLSS
dlss-full.master_processing_disable_policy: switch through normal DLAA Native path, hold native for 30 stable frames, request temporal jitter off, wait 400 ms, then enter native raw passthrough
dlss-full.master_processing_resume_policy: next launch always resumes processing ON and restores the saved reconstruction/NR state before A3-S5 startup stabilization
dlss-full.hardware_validation: RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, 2560x1440 output. Temporal synchronization was stable across Custom Ultra Quality (77%), Quality, Balanced, Performance and Ultra Performance. Automatic 1485x835 startup stabilization was confirmed to remove cold-start vibration. The ReShade UX/master v2 build was hardware-tested with repeated DLAA/DLSS mode changes and repeated processing OFF/ON transitions; the staged native transition avoided the earlier low-resolution -> OFF crash, and relaunch after OFF restored the saved mode so the startup prime remained active.
dlss-full.notes: The combined module installs both Super Resolution and the Neural Rendering runtime while leaving Neural Rendering disabled by default. Normal control lives in the ReShade GTA IV DLSS panel: master DLSS/DLAA processing, six reconstruction modes including DLAA Native, Neural Rendering, plus folded Advanced and Diagnostics sections. Master OFF is session-only and safely returns GTA to native before raw passthrough; the next launch restores the saved reconstruction/NR state and starts processing ON so A3-S5 can stabilize startup. DLSS-Full-Control.bat is launch/repair/diagnostics only. The frozen A3-S2/A3-S5 rendering core is preserved; pinned post-checkpoint stages add the public controls, startup-prime release fix and hardware-validated UX/master v2 behavior. The listed A3-S5 Feeder hash is the pre-UI hardware-reference binary; public_reshade_ux_reference_feeder_sha256 is the hardware-tested public v2 Feeder built on windows-2022. Local PE hashes can differ with MSVC revisions.
dlss-full.uninstaller_legacy_backup_support: Pre-presenter backups may omit .trex/d3d9vk_x64.dll; restore it from pinned b-bridge 0.1.0 package. Hashing uses .NET SHA-256 and does not depend on Get-FileHash.
dlss-full.startup_stabilization_frame_policy: 180 valid synchronized frames cumulative; explicit live DLSS/DLAA mode change cancels startup prime immediately

reshade.notes: Full Add-On Support, Vulkan global layer. The cross-process input patch is built from the exact v6.8.0 source tag.

nvngx_dlssnr.notes: Downloaded and hash-verified automatically by Install-DLSS-Full.bat. Known-good on RTX 4070 Ti SUPER. Installed to .trex/m3k/nvngx_dlssnr.dll and left OFF until the user enables Neural Rendering from Home -> Add-ons -> DLSS 5 Feed -> GTA IV DLSS.

m3k-dxvk-presenter.product: M3K DXVK render/output presenter for DLSS Super Resolution
m3k-dxvk-presenter.notes: Frozen M3K source-tap + A2-S1B presenter. Reads m3k-nr.ini, overrides GTA IV D3D9 render extent from RenderWidth/RenderHeight, and resizes the real presenter to OutputWidth/OutputHeight or the monitor when output is 0x0.
